technical_debt.release_docs_note: FIX-350: threshold raised 30->80. Keeping the full docs/release history is a deliberate strategy (release lineage reproducibility — check-release reads these files for released-version lineage), so the 74-token count is a permanent false WARN at 30. Archiving existing files is blocked by the check-release dependency; at 80 the advisory re-arms and archive candidacy must be re-evaluated. FIX-419 (arch D4 policy-threshold recalibration, revert evidence 7d6c4a7): raised 80->100 — measured 85 distinct version tokens over a 21-week in-repo history (~4.0/week overall; ~5.5/week in the FIX-350→FIX-419 hot window) re-tripped the FIX-350 threshold, and the archive migration path is disproven (docs/release subdirectory move trips loop-runtime-claim-gate ×3 — the registry anchors original paths; reverted in 7d6c4a7 undoing 263779f), leaving recalibration the only viable resolution. Budget: 100 = current 85 + headroom ≈3-4 weeks at measured rates, re-evaluate on next re-trip — archive-path feasibility must be re-assessed before any further raise. WARN semantics retained (check not removed); other faces (governance_data_size et al.) untouched. Drives check-technical-debt (28q).
